'''Rook''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He served the weapons designer [[Iram Radique]], who operated out of the prison.<ref name="Maul Lockdown" />
